verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party natural-language command interface for operating Modal, such as a built-in assistant or a chat-driven console. Modal ships an official SKILL.md for coding agents (modal-gh-3) and an llms.txt (modal-probe-1), but these are aids for third-party agents. The natural-language layer itself comes from the external agent, so this is adjacent support only and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
